//: Type checking for a codebase with no build step. Nothing here compiles anything —
`tsc --noEmit -p jsconfig.json` is a linter that happens to understand JSDoc.
The shapes live in js/types.js, which is NOT loaded by the page. Keep it free of
`import`/`export`: that would make it a module and its typedefs would stop being
`strict` is off on purpose. This is existing untyped code; turning it on produces
hundreds of nullability complaints that bury the few findings worth having.
`moduleDetection` must stay unset. `force` makes every file a module, and a
typedef inside a module is private to it — js/types.js would silently stop
applying anywhere, with tsc reporting "Cannot find name 'Med'" and nothing else.
